Customer data is kept for the life of the contract and for ninety days after it ends, so that a customer who returns within that window finds their records as they left them. After the ninety days every copy is deleted and the deletion is certified in writing.

## G-Cloud 15 Service Definition

When asked: What happens to our data at the end of the contract?

Retention is ninety days beyond termination. Within that window the customer may export everything as a single archive; after it, deletion is certified in writing within five working days.
